description: Executable Candidate binding of NVIDIA's official agent-ready Qwen3.6 35B-A3B NVFP4 checkpoint and stable vLLM 0.30 ARM64 image for one DGX Spark. Current qualification proves bounded text chat only; vision serving remains unproven on Spark.
title: NVIDIA Qwen3.6 35B-A3B NVFP4 vLLM single Spark
